tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

trace.error_message: Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after v2.3.1 was deployed to production (error rate 0.18). Release history shows v2.3.0 as the most recent production release that was healthy, so I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt failed partway with an orchestrator error after us-east (us-east moved to v2.3.0; us-west and eu-west stayed on v2.3.1). I retried the rollback to v2.3.0, which completed in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback status: v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy=true, error rate 0.002. Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial failure during rollback; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until fixed. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three regions and is healthy again (error rate 0.18 → 0.002). I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent production release marked healthy. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy release that caused the failures. v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging only.
- **What happened:** The first rollback attempt failed partway with an orchestrator error after us-east, leaving the service mixed (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). I retried the same rollback, and it completed in all regions.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to open INC-0001 timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and the service returned a single incident, so there should be no duplicate. The summary covers the failure, the partial rollback, the retry, and the post-rollback status.

Follow-ups for the team: find the cause of the v2.3.1 failure, investigate the orchestrator partial failure, and don't redeploy v2.3.1 until it's fixed. I didn't deploy anything, so the change-approval policy wasn't triggered.
